fact: The document states Togo's second national statistics development strategy, SNDS 2020-2024, was adopted by the Conseil National de la Statistique on 27 August 2020, with an action plan costed at 34.81 billion FCFA.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2020-2025.
INSEED states SNDS 2020-2024 was being implemented, with its remaining period to end-2025 to be covered by a revised action plan 2023-2025 put to national validation on 18-20 December 2023.
INSEED states a joint AFRISTAT, COMESA and PARIS21 mission carried out the mid-term evaluation of Togo's SNDS 2020-2024 on 5-9 December 2022.
